target_evidence: Research/Submission.lean:391–408 proves theorem_3_1: for every nonempty real list xs, nonnegative u, ExecutionModel add u xs, and (ceil(log2(length xs)))*u < 1, the actual algorithm output is the sum of xs.get i + Δ i with |Δ i| ≤ gamma(depth xs.length,u)*|xs.get i| for every original occurrence i. Lines 411–417 also prove the global rounding-model corollary.

requirements.requirement: The candidate proves the full requested theorem, not only a definition or example.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:391–408 proves the full universally quantified componentwise theorem, using the list theorem at 377–388 and tree induction at 345–373. depth is Nat.clog 2 n (45); depth_spec (475–476) characterizes it as the least integer bounding n by a power of two. gamma (255) is d*u/(1-d*u). IndependentChecks.lean restates and checks the full theorem with these definitions expanded.

requirements.requirement: The proved theorem applies to the requested algorithm and its output.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:53–70 implements equal-offset pairing, ceiling-half split, unchanged unmatched values, and exactly depth stages. roundValues_entry (92–105) proves the indexed pairing/carry rule. stages_length_ceiling (220–225), stage_offset (447–450), and stagesValues_length (453–462) connect offsets to ceil(n/2^(ell+1)). algorithm_eq_tree (245–252) and algorithm1_spec (465–472) connect the numerical result to the certified tree. algorithm_tree_spec (431–438) proves exact logarithmic tree height. Independent checks compile for all requested acceptance levels, singleton input, and a nonassociative operation detecting pairing and extra arithmetic on carries.

requirements.requirement: The result is connected to every occurrence in the original input.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:143–170 proves preservation as List.Perm, which preserves multiplicities; final_tree (227–242) connects root leaves to the original input. Lines 383–388 transport the occurrencewise Forall₂ bound back to original input order using perm_comp_forall₂. Lines 394–408 produce Δ indexed by Fin xs.length and bound every xs.get i. Independent checks include five equal inputs and verify their round [4,4,2] and final sum 10.

requirements.requirement: The requested componentwise backward-error conclusion is proved.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:307–335 establishes one-round error accumulation using gamma_step (261–277). tree_backward_error_local (345–373) constructs a separate perturbed value for every leaf and proves their sum equals tree evaluation. theorem_3_1 (391–408) then proves algorithm add xs = sum_i(xs.get i + Δ i) and the componentwise gamma bound, including singleton depth zero. IndependentChecks.lean compiles a restatement of precisely this conclusion.

requirements.requirement: The candidate does not assume, circularly encode, or vacuously imply the conclusion.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:285–294 defines ExecutionModel solely as the local relative-error model at each actual addition in the final expression tree; leaves require True and carried trees gain no node. It does not assume perturbations or a global backward bound. The theorem additionally assumes only nonempty input, nonnegative unit roundoff, and depth*u < 1. Lines 280–281 and 296–305 derive this local model from the standard global operation model. Exact addition witnesses consistency of the model.
